summary: SafeVault V2.1 follow-up — tested two new features: (1) Docs date-range filter chip + sheet, (2) EncryptedImagePreview component on doc detail. Both features work end-to-end on mobile web preview. No console errors. All testIDs from spec are present and correctly wired. Single-row regression for status/member filter rows is preserved (40px). For seeded PDF docs the preview correctly shows the preview-non-image placeholder.
critical_code_review_comments: DateRangeSheet preset grid wraps to 2-3 rows on a 390px viewport; presets that fall below the visible viewport require scroll_into_view in tests. Not a bug — just noted as a UX consideration if presets row should auto-scroll into view when sheet opens.
Pinch/pan gesture on EncryptedImagePreview cannot be exercised on web Playwright (touch gestures); component renders without errors and gesture-handler imports do not break web rendering — verified.
seed_data_creation: None — used built-in Demo Mode seed (6 PDF docs, 3 family members).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo Mode (login-demo-btn → onboarding-continue-btn) is the standard entry. Seeded docs are PDFs (mimeType: application/pdf), so EncryptedImagePreview correctly shows preview-non-image with no reveal-btn. To test the actual image reveal/pinch path, an image upload via /upload flow is required, but pinch gestures can't be triggered in Playwright web — only render verification is possible.
